statement: A Heavenly Stem combination (He) between two pillars' stems is traditionally read as harmony and bonding — a pull toward cooperation between whatever those two pillars represent, and, under the right supporting conditions, a transformation of their energy into a new element entirely.
editorial_note: Reflects a widely-repeated interpretation found throughout standard BaZi literature, exemplified by (not claimed as a verbatim quotation of) the cited source.
